messages.subject: R GSoC 2018 Slotting Projects
parts:
Google has given R plenty of slots for our top projects.

I have begun the process of assigning mentors who have selected 'want
to mentor'.

I have also begun the process of *preliminary* slotting of projects
because of the way the project conflict process works. We've already
lost one promising student to another organization who slotted their
proposal first.

Remember that program rules do not allow us to discuss likelihood of
acceptance or rejection with any of the students. Google reserves the
right of final approval of slots and notifying students for itself, and
takes a very negative view of organizations that speak out of turn.

I have commented on proposals that look strong, but don't have enough
mentor comments, or enough mentors selecting 'want to mentor'.

Mentors, please review the proposals for your projects to make sure
everything looks OK. If more information has been requested, please
provide it. If we need more mentors, lets get it taken care of. If
you have any issues or questions, please reach out to Toby and me as
soon as possible.

Google will announce accepted and passed-over proposals on April 23rd.

Regards,

Brian
